record.issue_text: [BUG] save_host dereferences params[:embeddable_host][:host] without verifying the embeddable_host key is present. A POST/PUT with an empty or malformed body crashes with NoMethodError on nil and returns a 500 instead of a 4xx error response.

adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`, the code directly dereferences `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `params[:embeddable_host][:category_id]` without checking that `params[:embeddable_host]` exists (`app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb` lines `host.host = params[:embeddable_host][:host]`). If a POST/PUT request omits the `embeddable_host` key or sends a malformed body, this will raise `NoMethodError` on `nil` and result in a 500 rather than a controlled 4xx error response.
